reviews.title: Good product so far, however
reviews.comment: I was under the assumption that this was a brand new, unopened card. This was clearly opened previously. I didn't see any signs of use, and it was extremely clean, but it was missing the protective covering on the slot, the antistatic seal was broken, and there was no taped ends on the box. The card appears to be genuine and works fine(only received it yesterday). I'm not unsatisfied so to speak, but I just really hope this card hasn't been used and abused, cleaned, sealed and resold.
reviews.author: Steve D.

reviews.title: A decent upgrade for my gaming pc
reviews.comment: I've had a gaming pc that I built myself for a few years now and, with all the new games being released now a days, it was time to finally start upgrading it. I was looking to try a Radeon graphics card for the first time since I was used to NVIDIA ones. When it comes to looks, it fits really well into my build and looks great with everything else. It was a bit noisier than I would have liked and I even made sure it wasn't just due to overheating. It did end up giving me more FPS in some of my favorite games which was very noticeable. I might stick with NVIDIA in the future but this was overall not a bad purchase and might recommend to someone looking for an upper end Radeon graphics card.
reviews.author: Maria Gomez

reviews.title: Notice the price tag
reviews.comment: Initially bought it thinking it was msrp. Turns out it is. But for almost 500 more than AMD’s or original version? (499 vs 959)That’s crazy. I’m essentially paying for resell at msrp. For that I’m going to take off 2 stars but I do like the design of it. Really want to give it zero dollars for the value category but it is what it is
reviews.author: Jonathan Wang

reviews.title: Gigabyte Software Is Trash
reviews.comment: As far as performance, the GPU is great. As far as gigabyte software, it's absolute garbage. VGA and RGB Fusion both look like they were designed in 2003 by a guy who had very little experience in his field. RGB Fusion consistently crashes my GPU and I finally just completely removed the software. So now I have a GPU that performs great, but with RGB that can't be controlled.
